title: AI-completed Beethoven Tenth Symphony premiered by the Beethoven Orchester Bonn on 9 October 2021
summary: AI-completed Beethoven Tenth premiered 9 October 2021 by Beethoven Orchester Bonn under Dirk Kaftan at the Telekom Forum, Bonn
account: On 9 October 2021 the Beethoven Orchester Bonn under Dirk Kaftan gave the world premiere of a Tenth Symphony completed with artificial intelligence. It was at the Telekom Forum in Bonn. Deutsche Telekom funded the project and organized the premiere, for Beethoven's 250th anniversary. Beethoven left only sketches for the work. A team led by musicologist Matthias Röder, with AI researcher Ahmed Elgammal and Mark Gotham, trained a model on Beethoven's output. It generated sketch continuations. Composer Walter Werzowa and musicologists chose and arranged the generated themes. Euronews reported on 13 October 2021 that the premiere had taken place in Bonn on 9 October. The benefit is a performed and recorded cultural artifact; the sources do not claim the result is Beethoven's.
purpose: Generate a completion of Beethoven's unfinished Tenth Symphony from his sketches in his style
system: Beethoven X AI generative music model (Elgammal/Playform AI team)
developer: Ahmed Elgammal (Rutgers University / Playform AI) with Mark Gotham
deployer: Deutsche Telekom (funder and concert organizer) with Beethoven Orchester Bonn

ratings.reason: Small: a sponsor-funded premiere programmed by the orchestra and broadcast live, per the orchestra's concert page
Small: one new performance and recording of a hypothetical completion; Euronews states humans chose and arranged the generated themes

ai_role.statement: The model generated candidate continuations of Beethoven's sketches. Humans (Werzowa and the musicologists) selected, arranged and orchestrated them, so the AI contribution was generative input within a human-curated process. The vendor-side accounts (Elgammal in The Conversation; Telekom) and the orchestra's own program page agree on the premiere.

data.retained_case_account: On 9 October 2021 the Beethoven Orchester Bonn under Dirk Kaftan gave the world premiere of a Tenth Symphony completed with artificial intelligence. It was at the Telekom Forum in Bonn. Deutsche Telekom funded the project and organized the premiere, for Beethoven's 250th anniversary. Beethoven left only sketches for the work. A team led by musicologist Matthias Röder, with AI researcher Ahmed Elgammal and Mark Gotham, trained a model on Beethoven's output. It generated sketch continuations. Composer Walter Werzowa and musicologists chose and arranged the generated themes. Euronews reported on 13 October 2021 that the premiere had taken place in Bonn on 9 October. The benefit is a performed and recorded cultural artifact; the sources do not claim the result is Beethoven's.

fields.account: On 9 October 2021 the Beethoven Orchester Bonn under Dirk Kaftan gave the world premiere of a Tenth Symphony completed with artificial intelligence. It was at the Telekom Forum in Bonn. Deutsche Telekom funded the project and organized the premiere, for Beethoven's 250th anniversary. Beethoven left only sketches for the work. A team led by musicologist Matthias Röder, with AI researcher Ahmed Elgammal and Mark Gotham, trained a model on Beethoven's output. It generated sketch continuations. Composer Walter Werzowa and musicologists chose and arranged the generated themes. Euronews reported on 13 October 2021 that the premiere had taken place in Bonn on 9 October. The benefit is a performed and recorded cultural artifact; the sources do not claim the result is Beethoven's.
